_comment: USD per million tokens, Anthropic first-party list prices (claude-api skill, cached 2026-09-25). Cache writes: 5m = 1.25x input, 1h = 2x input. A model id matches the longest key it starts with, so dated ids (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) and short aliases both resolve. Used for the LIVE estimate while a turn runs; the finished turn takes the CLI's own total_cost_usd.
